Die Erfindung betrifft auÃerdem eine Unterdruckhandhabungsvorrichtung zur DurchfÃ¼hrung des Verfahrens.The invention relates to a method for operating a vacuum handling device comprising a suction body with a suction chamber, which is designed such that the volume of the suction chamber when pressing against a workpiece to be gripped under deformation of the absorbent body is reduced, and comprising an auxiliary vacuum supply for evacuating the suction chamber, the Method comprising the following steps:
